punchboost.msg.server_disabled: Punch Boost was disabled by this server
punchboost.msg.no_bow: No bow with arrows in your hotbar
punchboost.msg.no_punch_bow: No Punch bow with arrows in your hotbar
punchboost.config.title: Punch Boost Settings
punchboost.config.reset.tooltip: Resets every option on this screen. Nothing is saved until you press Done.
punchboost.config.enabled.tooltip: Master switch. You can also bind a key to toggle this in Controls.
punchboost.config.pitch.tooltip: Where to look while drawing. -90 is straight up (the arrow falls back onto you and pushes you the way you were moving).
punchboost.config.yaw_offset.tooltip: Turn this many degrees from where you're facing before shooting. 0 = forward, 180 = behind you.
punchboost.config.charge_ticks.tooltip: How long to pull the bow. 3 ticks is the minimum that fires, 20 is full power. Shorter = arrow comes back sooner and hurts less.
punchboost.config.aim_delay.tooltip: Ticks to hold the aim before drawing so the server sees your new view direction. Keep at 1 or more on laggy servers.
punchboost.config.hold_after.tooltip: Ticks to keep the aim after letting go, before restoring your view.
punchboost.config.cooldown.tooltip: Ticks to wait after a shot before another can start.
punchboost.config.min_punch.tooltip: Only pick bows with at least this Punch level. Set to 'Any bow' to use any bow.
punchboost.config.restore_rotation.toolt: Snap your camera back to where you were looking afterwards.
punchboost.config.restore_slot.tooltip: Switch back to the item you were holding afterwards.
punchboost.config.repeat_held.tooltip: Keep firing as long as you hold the Boost key (respects the cooldown).
punchboost.config.show_messages.tooltip: Show short messages like 'No Punch bow in your hotbar'.
